name: Workout Tracker PWA
description: Single-project Vue 3 Progressive Web App for strength and CrossFit workout tracking with offline-first capabilities

name: Vue 3.5+
description: Latest Vue with reactive props destructuring, defineModel, and useTemplateRef

name: TypeScript (strict)
description: NO any, enum, or type assertions - uses unknown + type guards

name: Vite
description: Fast build tool with HMR for development

name: Pinia
description: State management for exercises and settings stores

name: Dexie (IndexedDB)
description: Repository pattern for offline-first data persistence

name: Vitest + Playwright
description: Browser mode testing with real DOM and navigation

name: shadcn-vue + Tailwind
description: Modern UI components with utility-first CSS

name: Bulletproof Feature-Based
description: ESLint-enforced dependency rules: Views → Features → Shared (features cannot import other features)

name: Repository Pattern
description: Database abstraction with Dexie for IndexedDB operations

name: Composable-First
description: Reusable reactive logic for timers, workout state, and UI interactions

name: Exercise Library
description: CRUD operations for custom exercises with categories and tracking modes

name: Workout Templates
description: Save and reuse workout configurations (Strength, AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata, ForTime)

name: Live Workout Execution
description: State machines for each workout type with timers and set tracking

name: Benchmark Tracking
description: Track performance on standard CrossFit benchmarks (Fran, Murph, etc.)

name: Timer Suite
description: Rest, AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata, and ForTime timers with state management

name: Integration Tests
description: Full user flow tests with createTestApp helper, real routing, and state

name: Composable Tests
description: Unit tests for composables using withSetup helper and Vue reactivity

name: Test Factories
description: Builder pattern for generating test data (workouts, exercises, users)

name: Fully Local
description: No PII tracking - all data stored in IndexedDB on device

name: Offline First
description: PWA capabilities with service worker for offline usage

name: ESLint Rules
description: Enforced patterns: tryCatch() for errors, RouteNames for routing, import boundaries

name: Type Safety
description: Strict TypeScript mode with NO any types allowed

name: Conventional Commits
description: Format: feat(workout): add rest timer with scope and type
